fields.statement: Re-ran b4bc38687's Checks in capped scopes: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run Spawn (exit 0; TestRunSpawnHolds/MemoryLow, TmpLow, DiskLow and NoHold pass), go test ./internal/run (exit 0), go vet ./internal/api ./internal/run (exit 0), TestScripts/(run-spawn|describe-golden)$ (exit 0, golden current without -update), rhiza ship generate and rhiza render (exit 0, no diff beyond this verifier's own actor). Diff read: spawnHoldDetail now holds on MachineHold (prefixed with its reason), DiskLow and TmpLow from the saved daemon state, naming reading and limit; the test saves each hold with daemon.WriteState, clears it on the ctx sleep's second call, asserts no child starts while held, exactly one spawn-held entry with role verifier and the reading/limit in its detail, the hold released in run state with SpawnHold.Role, and one child spawned; NoHold journals no entry and held is false. maxRuns, --no-wait and child-end recording untouched; no host reads, no TODOs.
